notes.title: Zak McKracken And The Alien Mindbenders: The LucasArts game you don't want to play any more
notes.notes:
Past Perfect is a retrospective column in which we look back into gaming history to see whether old favourites are still worth playing today.

I remember really loving Zak McKracken And The Alien Mindbenders. Richard Cobbett, frequently of this parish, always tells me that I am stupid and wrong and it was a terrible game. So I finally decided to prove him wrong.
